lhs: Strict binary32 nearest-even left fold of scalar add from +0 over concatenation A++B.
rhs: Independently fold A and B from +0 and add their scalar results in binary32.
types: Two static F32[2] tensors, scalar F32 output. Nonnegative exact integer inputs ≤ 2^24.
conditions: Axis zero concatenated and reduced; equal block shapes, single output, layout-insensitive. Fixed strict order with binary32 RNE per add. Pinned evaluator slow reduction path; default fast double accumulator and backend reassociation excluded.
overlap: Historical exact AddMonoid.concat-style identity; established r32 arithmetic reused. Counterexample concerns sequential value preservation under the stated grouping. Documented backend reassociation permitted.

lhs: Copy the materialized reshape of an operand, which may itself have been copied.
rhs: Omit or produce a copy into the chosen aligned layout, then materialize the reshape or reinterpret its buffer.
conditions: Equal row-major index across reshapes; omission requires a preceding copy and the same aligned layout as the base. Raw bitcast requires that the final and aligned layouts agree at every logical row. Cost and use-count selection only restrict this theorem. Source reachability for all four flag combinations has not been established.
types: Untiled static dense equal-width arrays over an arbitrary cell type, represented by bijections between logical row-major index and physical address.
overlap: Extends the historical copy pair with the original and new reshape paths. One mathematical result for four branch labels.

types: Untiled static dense equal-width arrays over an arbitrary cell type, represented by bijections between logical row-major index and physical address.
